description: Provider A is degraded; TensorFeed's signed ruling on the single best operational provider to fail over to for a task right now. Confirms A against the live incident-triage feed, then runs the route-verdict fusion with A (and any provider already in failover) excluded. Requires from. tier='preview' (default) is free (10 calls per day per IP), the failover target only. tier='full' costs 1 credit ($0.02), adds the full candidate (pricing, measured p95 latency, quality), the ranked alternatives, the confirmed incident on A, and an AFTA-signed receipt, and needs a TENSORFEED_TOKEN. Get credits at tensorfeed.ai/developers/agent-payments.

from.description: The degraded provider to fail over FROM (e.g. "anthropic", "openai"). Required.

task.description: Task type to optimize the failover target for. Optional.

tier.description: 'preview' (default, free) or 'full' (1 credit; adds candidate detail, ranked alternatives, incident, signed receipt).

name: failover_verdict
